description: Premium sneaker store whose own affiliate program is built for bloggers, influencers and content creators promoting through YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, blogs or Discord. Its own program page publishes a 3% commission on every successful order and an explicit unlimited-earnings statement - a verified-uncapped program - with a published business contact email for commission and collaboration questions.

evidence.summary: The brand's own affiliate page, under 'Why Join KICKSOWN?': 'Unlimited Earnings: No earning cap. The more you share, the more you earn.' - an explicit no-cap earnings statement on the brand's own program page, so commission_cap is uncapped.

The same page: 'Earn 3% Commission - Receive a 3% commission on every successful order made through your referral link.' Qualified influencers may receive free products and additional collaboration opportunities; commissions are processed at the end of every month with a $50 USD minimum payout, and the page publishes the contact cooperation@kicksown.com for commission or collaboration questions.

name: KICKSOWN

reasons.compensation: Verified-uncapped earnings on the brand's own page, but the rate itself is low at 3% per order, with a $50 minimum payout - the no-cap statement is explicit, the percentage is not generous.
reasons.contact_access: The program page publishes a named business contact for commissions and collaborations (cooperation@kicksown.com), plus support and feedback emails, a phone number and a street address - unusually direct access.
reasons.credibility: A small specialist sneaker store rather than an established footwear name, though its program page is detailed and current, with a real affiliate app and published payout terms.
reasons.niche_fit: Premium and performance sneakers are core sneakerhead and streetwear content - reviews, on-feet videos, styling and release coverage across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open sign-up through the brand's affiliate portal and mobile app, aimed at bloggers, influencers and content creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A creator-first program by design: it recruits influencers and content creators by name, names TikTok, Instagram and YouTube as promotion channels, and offers qualified influencers free products and review collaborations.

description: New multi-category DTC store (fashion items and accessories feature throughout its program examples) whose Creator Program launched with an effective date of June 22, 2026. Its own program page publishes a flat 10% commission on every sale with an explicit no-cap-on-earnings statement - a verified-uncapped program - no minimum follower requirement, a free first product for approved affiliates, and bonus commission tiers for top performers.

evidence.summary: The brand's own program page (Mova99 LLC, effective June 22, 2026) states in its commission structure 'The more you share, the more you earn - with no cap', and its FAQ answers 'How much do I earn per sale?' with 'You earn a flat 10% commission on every qualifying order placed through your referral link - with no cap on earnings.' An explicit no-cap earnings statement in the brand's own program terms, so commission_cap is uncapped.

The same page: 'There are no minimum follower requirements to join. Anyone can apply', with most applications reviewed within 24 hours; new affiliates receive 1 free product of their choice upon approval to create a first review; a Creator Bonus Program adds +2% to +5% bonus commission at monthly sales thresholds; tracking is a 30-day cookie with last-click attribution; and questions go to support@mova99.com. No absolute creator-count evidence is published, so creator_saturation stays unknown - a new program page alone is not a creator count.

name: Mova99

reasons.compensation: A brand-published flat 10% on every sale with an explicit no-cap-on-earnings statement - verified uncapped - plus +2% to +5% bonus tiers for top performers and no minimum payout amount.
reasons.contact_access: A published support email (support@mova99.com) with a stated 24-hour response time and an affiliate manager route for free-product requests; no dedicated partnerships inbox is published.
reasons.credibility: A very new, small multi-category store (program effective June 2026) with no established brand track record - the program terms are detailed, but the business itself is unproven, so credibility scores low.
reasons.niche_fit: Fashion items and accessories anchor the program's own examples (styling content for fashion/accessories is a named content category), though the store is multi-category rather than a pure fashion brand.
reasons.opportunity_availability: No minimum follower requirement, anyone can apply, most applications reviewed within 24 hours, and a free product on approval - the most open door in this round.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A program built specifically for creators and influencers: named content categories (unboxings, styling, before/after, comparisons), free products for content creation, and promotion explicitly across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube.

description: Occasionwear store - evening gowns, prom and wedding-guest dresses, plus jewellery and watches - whose own affiliate program pays creators 20% on every order through their link or code, with ready-made model photography provided so creators can post without buying product first. Its own fetched program page publishes no earnings-cap statement, so the cap is honestly unknown.

evidence.summary: The brand's own affiliate page: 'You earn 20% on every order that comes through your link or code. Not a one-time bonus - every single sale', with followers getting 10% off, monthly payouts to PayPal or bank, '0 follower minimum' and 'No product needed to start'. The same 20% and follower discount apply to every ring, bracelet, chain, earring and watch in the store. No earnings-cap statement appears on the fetched page, so commission_cap is unknown.

The page names its audience precisely: 'Pinterest creators with prom, wedding guest or evening wear boards', 'Instagram and TikTok creators who post get ready with me, fit checks or event looks', bloggers and Facebook group admins; it states 'Small accounts with engaged followers often sell more than big ones', supplies model shots of every gown from four angles for Pins, posts and Stories, and confirms creators from any country can join with worldwide shipping.

name: Styled

reasons.compensation: A brand-published 20% commission on every sale - among the strongest rates in this round - with a 10% follower discount to help conversion and monthly PayPal or bank payouts. No cap statement is published on the fetched page.
reasons.contact_access: No partnerships email is published on the fetched page - application is through the brand's affiliate portal.
reasons.credibility: A young direct-to-consumer occasionwear store with a thin public footprint compared with established fashion names; its program page is detailed and creator-specific, but the brand itself is unproven at scale.
reasons.niche_fit: Evening gowns, prom and wedding-guest dresses plus jewellery and watches are pure occasion-fashion content - GRWM, fit checks, dress roundups and event looks.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free to join with a zero follower minimum, no product purchase needed, and creators from any country accepted.
reasons.ugc_evidence: One of the most creator-specific program pages in this round: named creator types per platform, ready-made photography for posts, and an explicit welcome for small accounts.

description: Iconic outdoor clothing and gear brand founded in 1973, built around climbing, hiking, skiing, surfing and trail running. Its own affiliate page publishes an 8% base commission for content publishers, a dedicated affiliate manager, and a quick application process through Impact.

evidence.summary: The brand's own affiliate page lists Partner Benefits verbatim: '8% base commission for content publishers', 'Category-specific banners and text ads', 'Automated product feed', 'Dedicated Patagonia affiliate manager' and 'Quick and easy application process through Impact', with an Apply Here route into Impact. The brand says it is 'interested in teaming up with creative websites and businesses that share our passion for adventure and environmental stewardship'. No earnings-cap statement is published, so commission_cap is unknown.

name: Patagonia

reasons.compensation: An official 8% base commission for content publishers on premium-priced outdoor apparel and gear, with a dedicated affiliate manager - a strong, brand-confirmed rate for the category. No cap statement is published.
reasons.contact_access: A dedicated affiliate manager is promised on the brand's own page, but no partnerships email is published there - joining is through the Impact application.
reasons.credibility: One of the most recognised and trusted outdoor brands in the world, founded in 1973, with a decades-long environmental record.
reasons.niche_fit: Outdoor clothing and gear for climbing, hiking, skiing, surfing and trail running sit at the centre of travel and adventure creator content - gear lists, trip films and field reviews.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Quick and easy application through Impact per the brand's own page, with brand review of partner fit.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program is framed for creative websites and content publishers, with category-specific creative and an automated product feed; a conventional network program rather than a structured UGC track, but explicitly publisher-facing.

description: Outdoor brand founded in 1974 - high-performance clothing, tents, sleeping bags and backpacks for hiking, camping, skiing and climbing. Its own affiliate page publishes an 8% commission on valid sales tracked through CJ Affiliate, with no charge to participate and no minimum sale requirements.

evidence.summary: The brand's own affiliate page: 'Affiliate Commission Structure - 8% on valid sales', 'All sales are tracked through our neutral third party affiliate network CJ Affiliate', payout 'on or around the 20th of the month', and the FAQ 'What will it cost? Let us put this as clearly as possible: Nothing. There is no charge to participate in the Marmot Affiliate Program and no minimum sale requirements.' Anyone may submit an application; Marmot reviews each site. No earnings-cap statement is published, so commission_cap is unknown. The page's Contact Us email is obfuscated in the fetched text, so no email is recorded.

Travelpayouts' outdoor program comparison independently lists Marmot at 8% commission via CJ, agreeing with the brand's own published structure, and several camping roundups report a 90-day cookie for the CJ program; a FlexOffers syndication listing shows a lower 2.4%, which is a reseller feed figure and does not displace the brand's own 8%.

name: Marmot

reasons.compensation: A brand-published 8% on valid sales through CJ, independently agreed by outdoor program comparisons - a solid rate on technical gear with high order values. No cap statement is published.
reasons.contact_access: The brand's page routes questions to its Affiliate Network Manager, but the email is obfuscated in the fetched page, so no contact is recorded; joining is through CJ.
reasons.credibility: A leader in technical outdoor gear since 1974, with the program run through CJ Affiliate's established tracking and payments.
reasons.niche_fit: Jackets, tents, sleeping bags and packs are staple hiking, camping and mountain-travel content - kit reviews, camp setups and weather tests.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Anyone may submit an application through CJ with a live site; no participation charge and no minimum sale requirements, though Marmot reviews each site.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A conventional network affiliate program with supplied banners, logos and link tools aimed at outdoor publishers; no dedicated creator track is evidenced on the fetched page.

description: Resistance-training equipment brand from New Richmond, Wisconsin - band handles, 41-inch loop resistance bands and footplates built to make strength training accessible without bulky gym equipment. Its own Refersion affiliate portal publishes a referral rate of 20% of revenue (excluding shipping and taxes) on sales within a 30-day cookie, paid on the 1st of each month.

evidence.summary: The brand's own Refersion affiliate portal: 'As an Clench Fitness affiliate, you earn based on your referral sales during a revolving 30 Day Period... Referral Rate = 20% of Revenue (excludes shipping and taxes)', with its worked example 'You refer a sale that is $117 total but taxes were $7 and shipping was $10. You Earn: 20% on sales of $100 = $20', a 30-day referral cookie, and 'Payments of commissions are paid on the 1st of each Month for the previous month.' No earnings-cap statement is published, so commission_cap is unknown.

Refersion's own fitness-equipment roundup independently lists Clench Fitness at '20% commission', 'Cookie days: 30' and 'AOV: $155', agreeing with the brand's portal terms, and describes its band handles, loop bands and footplate line for home and travel training.

name: Clench Fitness

reasons.compensation: A brand-published 20% of revenue on referred sales - the strongest verified rate among this round's fitness entries - on a $155 average order value per Refersion's roundup. No cap statement is published.
reasons.contact_access: A published company contact email (info@clenchfitness.com) plus application review through the brand's Refersion portal; no dedicated partnerships inbox is published.
reasons.credibility: A small specialist equipment maker (Wisconsin-based, small team) rather than a national fitness brand, though its program terms are published in full on its own portal.
reasons.niche_fit: Resistance bands and handles are home-workout, travel-training and apartment-gym staples - exactly the equipment fitness creators demo daily.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Online application through the brand's Refersion portal with brand review; the brand may reject unsuitable sites at its discretion.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The portal is written for affiliates promoting through 'your site, blog, or social media outlets', and Refersion's roundup positions the brand for home-fitness creators - a genuine creator route, though not a structured UGC campaign track.

description: Travel-comfort brand behind the Trtl Pillow - the mechanically engineered travel pillow - plus sleep masks, compression socks and travel accessories. Its own affiliate terms confirm a program powered by Social Snowball with referral codes and links and a content usage-rights licence for affiliates, but the brand publishes no commission rate in its terms and directory figures conflict, so no rate is recorded.

evidence.summary: The brand's own Affiliate Marketing Program Terms: 'Welcome to the Trtl Travel Affiliate Marketing Program, powered by Social Snowball... Affiliates will receive a unique referral code and/or link to share with potential new customers. Commissions are earned on qualifying sales that are directly attributable to the affiliate's referral code or link.' The terms set no percentage ('Commission rates are subject to change at Trtl's discretion') and grant Trtl a licence to use affiliate content for organic and paid advertising including on Meta and TikTok. No earnings-cap statement is published, so commission_cap is unknown.

Published rates conflict: Lasso lists Trtl at 'Up to 22.5%' with a 14-day cookie, while Shopper's partnership listing and InfluencerRate both report 5-10%. Because the brand's own terms publish no rate and the directories disagree, commission_rate is null.

name: Trtl

reasons.compensation: No rate is recorded: the brand's own terms publish no percentage and directory figures conflict (up to 22.5% versus 5-10%), so compensation scores cautiously despite the brand's strong product price points. No cap statement is published.
reasons.contact_access: No partnerships email is published in the fetched sources - joining is through the brand's site and its Social Snowball program.
reasons.credibility: A well-known single-product-led travel brand - the Trtl Pillow is a category-defining travel accessory sold worldwide.
reasons.niche_fit: Travel pillows, sleep masks and compression socks are demo-friendly flight and travel-hack content - long-haul comfort tests are a proven creator format.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application via the brand's program with approval at the brand's discretion, per its own terms (applicants must be 18+ with a valid payment method).
reasons.ugc_evidence: A creator-native program structure: referral codes and links via Social Snowball and an explicit content usage-rights licence covering affiliate content on Meta and TikTok - the brand is set up to reuse creator content in paid and organic channels.
